environment.description: AWS Lambda function invoked as a task within a Step Functions Express workflow. The workflow is triggered by an API Gateway HTTP API (v2) endpoint at POST /workflow/start. API Gateway has no authorization configured (AuthorizationType: NONE). The API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible with a default execute-api endpoint. CloudWatch logs are enabled at INFO level, and the Step Functions execution history (including task outputs with error messages) is queryable via the DescribeExecution API. No rate limiting is configured on the API Gateway stage.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API v2, public endpoint, no auth, no throttling
config.network: Public internet accessible, no VPC, no IP restrictions
